prompt_head:
Role: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) Professional experience building and dep

assessments.note: About 4 years shipping LangGraph agent systems end to end, including Job Fit Agent.
Python and TypeScript used to build AI pipelines and applications.
Shows tracing, context pipelines, and tools, but not permissions or controls.
Built LangGraph and multi-stage agent pipelines with orchestration and human review.
Uses LangGraph state-machine agent graphs with human approval steps.
Lists LLM evals and HITL review, but no benchmark or regression suite design shown.
Covers prompting, structured outputs, and RAG, but no explicit trade-off analysis.
Langfuse tracing added to a shipped agent for observability.
Shipped APIs with FastAPI, Postgres, Docker, CI, and Cloudflare infrastructure.
Onboarded enterprise clients and delivered demos with cross-functional teams.
Architect role implies communication, but explaining AI risks and trade-offs is not shown.
No evidence of travel or on-site client delivery.
Built LangGraph agents and uses Claude Code orchestrator workflows.
Cloudflare Workers experience only; no AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud shown.
No Claude architect certification; only Claude Code skill and unrelated certs.

output.verdict_line: The candidate has strong agent-building and Python/TypeScript evidence with about 4 years of experience, but evaluation design depth, harness controls, and travel are not shown.
top_gaps: Evaluation system design for AI applications, such as benchmarks, regression suites, and production monitoring
Harness controls and permissions for AI agents
Ability to travel for client workshops or on-site delivery
